turns.question: What was our refund rate by value on the orders placed on 1 and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no refund-rate-by-value metric, so I cannot give that figure; the closest are return_rate (share of orders returned, counted by order, not by value) and returns_eur (Returns (EUR), the sum of partner return amounts), with revenue_eur (Revenue (EUR)) as the gross base. No query was run for this turn, so there is no freshness statement to quote.
